verdict.rationale: Codex cloud runs delegated tasks in isolated cloud environments, configured per repository with dependencies and setup steps. The user then reviews a summary and diff, requests follow-ups, or opens a pull request, which covers the build-and-review part of the story. Running tests in the cloud is only implied by the environment setup, and nothing in the evidence shows the agent producing a demo (preview, screenshots, or recording) for review. missing for 10: explicit cloud test-execution evidence, demo/preview artifacts of the built feature, independent hands-on corroboration of end-to-end cloud runs.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a cloud agent build, test, and demo a feature end-to-end for my review

citations.quote: Run tasks in isolated cloud environments, work in parallel
Configure the dependencies, tools, variables, and setup steps each repository needs.
Inspect the summary and diff, request a follow-up, or open a pull request when the result is ready.
Delegate a longer task and return when it is ready.
If you are looking for the cloud-based agent from OpenAI, Codex Web, go to chatgpt.com/codex.
